name: mlm-portal
description: Navarth Wellness distributor portal — Backend (Node.js REST API: Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL + Swagger) and Frontend (React)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix Backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix Backend run db:migrate && npm --prefix Backend run db:extras && npm --prefix Backend run db:seed
scripts.build: npm --prefix Backend run build && npm --prefix Frontend run build
